faq.q: Does HCAD's value establish the minimum offer I should accept?
faq.a: No. First identify which value you are reading and its valuation date. Compare current property evidence, realistic sale alternatives and written proposals; the tax value alone does not decide your sale.

faq.q: Are HCAD market value and appraised value always the same?
faq.a: No. HCAD explains that market value reflects its January 1 estimate, while appraised value may be the same or lower when a cap applies. Read the labels on the actual record.

faq.q: Does an offer below the tax value prove a cash buyer is right?
faq.a: No. Ask what property facts, repair scope and sale assumptions explain the proposal. You can question the comparison, seek a current market opinion or decline an offer that does not fit.

faq.q: Does accepting an offer automatically change my HCAD record?
faq.a: Do not assume that a purchase discussion changes the appraisal record or resolves a tax issue. Keep the sale decision separate from any appraisal question and ask the appropriate professionals about your circumstances.
